reviewer: AI (Claude) independent reviewers (blind solve + informed review), separate from the author; not a native-speaker or teacher review

set.q: We listened to the birds ____ in the trees.
set.why: listen to + 목적어(the birds) + 현재분사(-ing)는 '새들이 노래하고 있는 것을 듣다'라는 뜻이에요. sang, sings처럼 시제가 있는 동사는 the birds 뒤에 접속어 없이 이어 쓸 수 없고, to sing은 뜻이 맞지 않아요.

patches.why: explanation wording only; question, options and key unchanged

criteria: single defensible answer (blind solve), natural English, level, distractor validity, hint and explanation
